recipes.name: Magmawake Inscription
recipes.source_encounter: Ragnaros, Molten Core raid encounter
recipes.host: One existing caster main-hand weapon; the custom inscription host is supplied separately and not consumed.
recipes.wearer_gate: Character level 60 or higher and native ability to equip the existing host under its class, level, skill, and proficiency rules. Naturally know and be permitted to cast a direct hostile Fire spell and a direct hostile spell of a different native school; no spell is granted. The existing host and wearer role must pass a reviewed per-host effect-power budget; if no compatible role/budget is admitted, the inscription cannot be attached.
recipes.artisan_gate: Custom Runesmithing career rating at least 450 with this transferable pattern learned; useful-work mastery only, performed at a city workshop. This custom career grants no native profession skill, character XP, class ability, or bypass of host requirements; the artisan need not visit the source encounter.

mechanic.trigger: During hostile NPC combat, complete two direct hostile spell casts of different native schools against the same hostile NPC within 8 seconds; one cast must be Fire school.
mechanic.effect: After the school-pair primes heat, the next completed direct Fire spell against a hostile NPC opens a self-only casting-tempo window; it causes no additional damage or spell.
mechanic.numbers: 8% spell haste for 3 seconds after that Fire cast; one charge per window and no rune-added mana or cooldown reduction.
mechanic.maintenance: Exceptional charged signature; exact capacity and ordinary city refill bill are in the maintenance record.

maintenance.durability: The host remains ordinary durable equipment; only the signature is charged.
maintenance.zero_charge_behavior: At zero charges the rune is inert; the host remains usable and keeps its normal equipment behavior.
maintenance.identity: Charge count and ICD remain bound to this item and wearer family through trade, equip swaps, and relog; swaps cannot reset them.

recipes.teaching: A transferable Magmawake pattern blueprint is proposed as loot only after an eligible character participates in the exact Ragnaros encounter and victory is recorded. A city artisan can study it once at a workshop without entering the raid. The separate Ragnaros Ember Relic is consumed once per commission; this is future custom loot, not an existing drop.
recipes.maker_reward: One proposed mastery credit only for a completed paid useful order with inputs and result receipted and returned to the requester on an approved existing host. Guild or same-account supply is allowed. A credit requires a distinct useful order or a materially new inscription revision; no-op reapplications, authorship, idle time, relic pickup, and recycling earn nothing. Counts toward proposed specialization or alphabet teaching.
recipes.bot_rules: Craft only at a city workshop with the qualified artisan present, safe, and supplied with the reserved bill; elapsed time is active workshop time. Signatures work against any eligible genuine hostile NPC; source encounter rules gate only proposed blueprint and relic acquisition.
recipes.abuse_rules: Require two distinct native hostile spell schools against one hostile NPC, including Fire, then consume the primed state on one completed Fire cast. Ignore self, friendly, pet, environmental, training, probe, factory, and arranged events; no recursion, stacked rune haste, or ICD reset.
dependencies: Future context-bound custom blueprint and relic drops; custom Runesmithing mastery and workshop commissioning; reviewed host compatibility, event provenance, and proc adapter. No native IDs or implementation are admitted.
Proposed wearer level floor and per-host role/effect-power budget require review before attachment.

services.name: Inspect or restore one rune imprint

inspection.fee: quote separately in real guild currency; no price proposed

restore_imprint_record.fee: quote separately in real guild currency; no price proposed

services.effect_and_rights: Inspection reports the exact item's recorded admitted recipe, identity, charges and state without changing them. Restoration repairs only that same recorded inscription after a verified state fault; it cannot change the pattern, effect, host, owner, capacity, or remaining charges. Require item owner or current guild representative authority and the item's intact recipe entitlement record; no boss entitlement is consumed or recreated.
services.custody_failure_transfer_and_version: Work on one exact original item GUID at an approved city station, with custody held until a committed receipt. If completion or binder consumption is uncertain, hold for reconciliation; do not retry from timeout. Record service profile version, mode, input receipt, item GUID and before/after state in a once-only receipt. Transfers retain item identity and state; recheck owner and authority after transfer.

services.name: Re-inscribe one existing host

bill_parameters.inputs: Consume exactly one target recipe's admitted component bill OR its expanded raw bill, never both; include any recipe-specific Runic Binder once as part of that bill.
bill_parameters.fee: quote separately in real guild currency; no price proposed

services.effect_and_rights: Replace one existing admitted pattern with one different explicitly admitted pattern compatible with the exact host. Require owner consent, target recipe entitlement, wearer/class/equip and artisan gates, and its full current-version input bill. The old pattern and any unused charges end on commit; no refund, extra host, free component, or relic. A source-encounter blueprint is transferable knowledge only where that recipe says so; each new legendary commission still consumes its one physical relic.
services.custody_failure_transfer_and_version: Keep the same host item GUID and target materials in held custody through native completion; commit one before/after inscription receipt tied to target recipe and bill version. Unknown outcome stays held until native input and item state are reconciled. Recheck owner, entitlement and host compatibility after any transfer; no progress or input reservation moves to a different item implicitly.

services.name: Restore optional exceptional charges

bill_parameters.eligibility: Only a recipe that explicitly defines finite optional exceptional-power charges and a refill bill may use this service.
bill_parameters.inputs: Consume ceil(charges_restored / recipe_charges_per_refill_bill) copies of the exact recipe-version refill bill; add no default Runic Binder or other universal reagent, and never consume the relic core.
bill_parameters.bill_scaling: recipe_charges_per_refill_bill and the corresponding exact input bill are declared by the target recipe; charge restoration is capped at recipe_capacity.
bill_parameters.example: A recipe may define a five-charge refill batch; five is illustrative only and does not set a shared service limit.
bill_parameters.fee: quote separately in real guild currency; no price proposed

services.effect_and_rights: Only the exact recorded recipe effect and capacity can be refilled. The target recipe defines whether this service exists, its refill bill, charges restored per bill, maximum restore per service, and zero-charge behavior. At zero charges the recipe's declared passive remains; only the optional charged effect stops. Durable field runes have no charge meter or routine upkeep. Require custody of the exact item and its recipe identity; refill does not grant blueprint rights, reset an item-family cooldown, alter the passive, exceed capacity, or restore a consumed relic.
services.custody_failure_transfer_and_version: Hold the exact item GUID and refill inputs until one committed charge receipt binds service version, recipe version, input identities, and before/after charges. Unknown completion is held for reconciliation, never retried by timeout. Charges and item-family cooldown identity persist through trade, bank movement, owner change and relog; a transfer does not refill or reset them. Recheck current owner/authorized custodian and recipe-specific eligibility after transfer.

glyphs.evidence: Observed voluntary distance closure by the wearer toward a legal hostile target during combat; exclude knockback, pull, teleport, scripted movement, and server correction.
glyphs.role: Select deliberate pursuit as the initiating event.
glyphs.cap: One approach contribution per hostile target per admitted interval; position samples alone cannot create repeated progress.

compatibility.notes: The outcome may aid the wearer but cannot move the wearer or target.

glyphs.evidence: Two distinct successful native hostile spell casts by the wearer, with different admitted schools/forms and unique cast IDs inside the admitted window; exclude item procs and duplicate callbacks.
glyphs.role: Recognize deliberate alternating magic without naming or granting a class spell.
glyphs.cap: One completed pair per item per admitted interval; each cast contributes at most once and excess casts do not bank.

compatibility.notes: Native cast, resource, class, and target checks remain authoritative.

glyphs.evidence: A successful native heal to a living friendly with verified recent hostile injury in the same admitted combat; recipient GUID, healer, native heal event, actual amount, and injury provenance must match. Exclude overheal and self-healing.
glyphs.role: Select useful healing rather than raw healing volume.
glyphs.cap: At most one contribution per heal event and one per injured recipient per admitted interval; actual missing health bounds contribution.

compatibility.notes: A release may target only a still-living eligible friendly and cannot heal more than its admitted cap.

glyphs.evidence: The wearer survives a witnessed hostile opener in a newly identified engagement; require hostile source and exact damage event provenance.
glyphs.role: Recognize survival through an opening threat.
glyphs.cap: One contribution per hostile engagement and item cooldown; no re-arming from combat-log replay, self-damage, or repeated damage from the same opener.

compatibility.notes: Survival never means resurrection, death prevention, or immunity.

glyphs.evidence: A short ordered sequence of two distinct successful native hostile combat event types with unique event IDs, actor/target provenance, and no proc origin.
glyphs.role: Offer a general rhythm trigger when a design names the exact qualifying event types.
glyphs.cap: One sequence per item per admitted interval; sequence length, window, and event types are fixed per admitted design, never user-configurable at runtime.

compatibility.notes: This constrained sequence is not a general event wildcard.

glyphs.evidence: Receives one already accepted block, parry, approach, or admitted combat-cadence token with a unique cause event ID.
glyphs.role: Turn qualifying impact/approach evidence into a bounded primed token for a later release.
glyphs.cap: Maximum two tokens; one per source event; fixed short expiry; clear after one release or expiry.

compatibility.notes: Stores no damage for later replay and grants no resource.

glyphs.evidence: Receives only admitted, successful hostile fire-school cast evidence or a named fire event in the cadence, with unique native event provenance.
glyphs.role: Build a small, expiring heat state for an explicitly fire-themed release.
glyphs.cap: Maximum two heat tokens; one per cause event; short fixed expiry; a release consumes the priming state once.

compatibility.notes: The exact school and target rules are declared by each admitted design.

glyphs.evidence: Receives a completed eligible spell-alternation or explicitly admitted arcane cadence sequence; retain cast IDs and school distinction.
glyphs.role: Convert alternating native spell evidence into one focused release opportunity.
glyphs.cap: One primed opportunity at a time; short expiry; no mana or other resource is generated or refunded.

compatibility.notes: A pursuit pairing requires an explicitly named admitted arcane event sequence; movement alone supplies no spell evidence.

glyphs.evidence: Receives one accepted block, parry, steadfast-hold, ambush-survival, or named defensive cadence token.
glyphs.role: Prepare one bounded protective opportunity without applying an effect during buildup.
glyphs.cap: One protective token; short expiry; consumed once; cannot stack with another rune absorb beyond the admitted family ceiling.

compatibility.notes: Cannot create immunity or bypass an existing native damage resolution.

glyphs.evidence: Receives one accepted mercy-heal token with recipient identity and verified actual healing/missing-health context.
glyphs.role: Shape a bounded support opportunity from useful healing.
glyphs.cap: One recipient-bound token; cap by actual useful healing and recipient missing health; expires quickly and clears after release.

compatibility.notes: No overheal, autonomous repeat healing, or healing feedback is retained.

glyphs.evidence: Accepts exactly two causal records with different native event IDs. The admitted design names both predicates and one fixed discriminator: native event type, spell school, or injured-recipient GUID. Event-type pairs must match the two named types; school pairs require separate successful cast IDs and different named schools; recipient pairs require separate qualifying heal IDs and different recipient GUIDs. No one event may fill both halves; reject an unrestricted different-anything wildcard.
glyphs.role: Require the exact recipe-named two-record pair and discriminator before one composed release.
glyphs.cap: One pair, one primed opportunity, short fixed expiry; a native event cannot fill both halves.

compatibility.notes: The admitted design fixes both predicates and their discriminator; pair evidence must have separate causal event IDs. This is not an arbitrary event combiner.

glyphs.evidence: Immediately revalidate that the original hostile source remains alive, hostile, attackable, and legal for a direct hit; bind resolution to the claimed event and item.
glyphs.role: Deliver one bounded response against the causal hostile attacker.
glyphs.cap: One target and one hit; magnitude is capped by the admitted design and causal event; no chain, splash, forced movement, or recursion.

compatibility.notes: If pre-claim target validation fails, no settlement or charge debit occurs.

glyphs.evidence: Revalidate the admitted wearer or eligible ally and a compatible short-duration absorb family before the claimed release is applied.
glyphs.role: Grant one bounded defensive absorb to an admitted recipient.
glyphs.cap: One absorb instance; total value and duration have explicit per-design ceilings; no stacking beyond the family ceiling; no invulnerability.

compatibility.notes: Absorbed damage is settled once and does not become rune trigger evidence.

glyphs.evidence: Resolve once for the wearer after the claimed release; check active rune-family haste limits and current item entitlement.
glyphs.role: Offer a brief self-only attack or casting tempo window.
glyphs.cap: One short window with an explicit per-design ceiling; no stacking, extra turns, movement control, or proc chain.

compatibility.notes: An admitted design selects attack or cast tempo and cannot grant both unless separately admitted.

glyphs.evidence: Resolve once for the wearer after the claimed release; verify alive state, legal location, and effect-family cap.
glyphs.role: Offer a brief defensive or self-directed escape aid.
glyphs.cap: One short self-only window with explicit magnitude and duration ceilings; no teleport, forced movement, immunity, or repeated refresh.

compatibility.notes: The wearer chooses any movement; the release does not reposition any unit.

glyphs.evidence: Revalidate the exact living friendly recipient, current missing health, and one claimed useful-heal token.
glyphs.role: Deliver one small follow-up heal to the qualifying injured friendly.
glyphs.cap: One heal, one recipient, capped by the admitted design and current missing health; no overheal credit, repeat, or healing feedback.

compatibility.notes: A release heal is rune-origin and cannot qualify another mercy-heal pattern.

glyphs.evidence: Revalidate one legal hostile target and the admitted element/school. Bind the burst to the claimed native cast or impact evidence.
glyphs.role: Deliver one bounded single-target elemental response.
glyphs.cap: One target, one hit, one admitted school, and an explicit per-design magnitude ceiling; no splash, chain, forced movement, or recursion.

compatibility.notes: No class spell, free mana, or automatic school proficiency is granted.

examples.meaning: A witnessed hostile parry primes one capped hit on the still-legal original attacker. A shield-block version using guard_block is a separate admission.
A voluntary hold under threat primes one brief personal absorb without rooting or moving the wearer.
Voluntary closure toward a hostile target primes a capped, short self-only tempo window without forced movement.
Two distinct successful hostile spells of alternating admitted schools prime one bounded single-target burst.
A useful heal to a genuinely injured living friendly primes one capped echo on that still-injured recipient; rune-origin healing cannot feed another proc.
Surviving one witnessed hostile opener primes a short self-only defensive window with no teleport, forced movement, or death prevention.
